answer: You can pay the difference at your appointment with a cashier's check or a debit card; we don't accept personal checks or credit cards. You don't need a payoff letter, because Lakeshore Bank is in our e-payoff network: we confirm the payoff with them directly the same day, at your appointment, using your loan account number. If you'd rather not pay the difference, you can keep the car, since an offer never obliges you to sell.
